name: Drop To Path
description: 【实用工具】 DSH 插件:图片与文件直达纯文本模型——图片保留原生附件体验,PDF/Office/压缩包/视频/音频显示为附件栏方块,点击发送时自动转为工作区路径,配合 dsh-vision-toolkit 粘贴即看图。A DSH plugin that delivers images AND files to text-only models as workspace paths: images keep the native attachment UI, other files show as square chips in the rail, paths append on send — pairs with dsh-vision-toolkit.
descriptionEn: DSH 插件:图片与文件直达纯文本模型——图片保留原生附件体验,PDF/Office/压缩包/视频/音频显示为附件栏方块,点击发送时自动转为工作区路径,配合 dsh-vision-toolkit 粘贴即看图。A DSH plugin that delivers images AND files to text-only models as workspace paths: images keep the native attachment UI, other files show as square chips in the rail, paths append on send — pairs with dsh-vision-toolkit.
author: MingLin
